label: Modbus to MQTT
info: Polls the devices in the Node-RED device registry over one Modbus TCP connection per host:port, stores each reading in a durable outbox and publishes it to iot/<device-id>/telemetry once the broker acknowledges it. Settings: this tab's environment variables (GATEWAY_*, BROKER_*, MQTT_* is the first-boot broker).
